name: Meilge

attributes.attribute: an Irish hero who shot the bewitched fawn Aige
had boils rise on his face from Faifne's satire
had the satirical poet killed in return

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Meilge is an Irish hero. He shot a fawn. The fawn was a bewitched maiden called Aige. Aige's brother Faifne punished him. Faifne spoke a satire so fierce that boils rose on Meilge's face. Meilge answered in blood. He had the poet-satirist killed.
objective: Document Meilge, the Irish hero, and the satire that scarred him.
key_results: killed the fawn that was the maiden Aige
the satire by Faifne raised boils on his face
he revenged himself on the poet
evidence: Monaghan, P. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore (2008): Meilge, p. 322.
